verdict.rationale: Codex is a coding agent focused on code generation, editing, review, and CLI/cloud task automation; there is no evidence of any capability to attach to or inspect a live running web application (e.g., browser DevTools integration, runtime debugging, log/network inspection of a live app). Debugging a live running app is a different axis (runtime observability/dev-tools) than code editing and static review, which is what this product's evidence covers.
